answer: Because Northwind Auto Finance is in our e-payoff network, you don't need a payoff letter; we confirm the payoff amount directly with the lender the same day, at your appointment, using your loan account number. However, the help center doesn't say how long it takes for the loan to actually show as paid off after the sale, so please contact a store for that timing. Don't skip your next payment: keep making regular payments until your lender confirms the loan is paid off, because a missed payment can be reported as late on your credit history. If an extra payment goes through after the payoff, your lender refunds it directly to you, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed.
